zyntschnur.text: Zyntschnur brings a sharp, complete game: matchup rating up among the very best, bravery close to the top, and a rhythm that never cools. The accuracy is near the top, so is the headshot share, and the lifetime board confirms the matchups. This one rests on an older, smaller opponent sample, so treat it as a sketch.

zyr0seunc.text: Zyr0sEUNC plays a full, balanced game: stands alongside the best tracked over nearly every count, a fast tempo, and unruffled as fights harden. The numbers keep up as the opposition strengthens. Its lifetime ledger matches the matchups, a clean agreement. A strong regular, through and through.

zyr0sncx.text: Zyr0sNCx plays a complete game: stands at the peak of the board across nearly every measure, a brisk rhythm, and resolute as fights harden. The numbers hold as the opposition strengthens. Its edge holds firm against the strongest third. The lifetime board paints the same picture as the matchups, a clean agreement.

zyr0s.text: Zyr0s has played since 2018 and still plays flat out: among the very best tracked, blazing tempo behind it, raising the output against stronger opposition. The matchup kill-death numbers sit near the top, and the strongest-third edge slips a touch. A veteran game, still at full speed.

zialvs.text: ZialVS plays a balanced, top-shelf game: sharp in the matchups, steady in the face of harder foes, with bravery near the top too, and accuracy sitting near the summit. Consistency is the lone mid-pack line on an otherwise upper-tier sheet. Both boards agree: a balanced card, end of story.

zaazaawuying.text: ZaaZaaWuYing is a young account carrying a truly complete game: top shelf in the matchups, and accuracy at the ceiling. The edge holds against the hardest third too, which is rare this early on. Early read, though the opening pages already carry some serious weight.

zthassassinsssssssssssssssssssss.text: zthAssassinsssssssssssssssssssss picks the moment, then ends it: bravery sits near the bottom, yet the matchup kill-death mark lands among the very best tracked, with resistance near the top. The pace is middling, accuracy below average, headshots nearly absent, and the lifetime IvI near the bottom — the matchups see a far deadlier game than the lifetime board does. Consistency trails below average, but the chosen fights are won decisively.

zoogie.text: Zoogie has been at it since 2013, and the card reads like a masterclass: matchup rating, activity, bravery, resistance, and matchup kill-death all sitting in the top ranks, with a pace to match. Precise aim, plenty of headshots, and the lifetime ledger tells the same story. Even against the strongest third, the game barely slips — a veteran who still sets the pace.

zewgie.text: Zewgie has been dueling since 2012, and the record is rich: the matchup kill-death mark hovers near the top, with rating, tempo, bravery, resistance — all holding in the upper tier. Accuracy sits above average, the headshot share top-shelf, while the lifetime IvI holds the upper tier too. Read this as a sketch, mind you — the opponent sample is older and smaller, leaving the edges soft.

zouiette.text: ZouIette builds wins on precision and poise: rating, tempo, bravery, resistance — the matchup kill-death line sits right beside it, with rating, tempo, bravery, resistance — every adjusted line in the upper tier. The headshot share is only middling, and the lifetime IvI rests mid-pack — the lifetime board undersells what the matchups prove. A steady, complete player whose best work shows up where it counts.

zzerocoollruss.text: ZzeroCoollRUSS plays a sharp, high-tempo game built on output near the top. The game keeps its edge as the opposition improves, with the matchup rating near the top, though the lifetime board sits a step below the matchups, and the consistency mark dips below average. Treat this one as a rough draft, not the finished work: the opponent sample behind it comes from an older, smaller pool.

zugie.text: Zugie has been winning since 2013: rating, activity, bravery, resistance — every line near the top — and kills arriving at a top rate. Aim sharp, headshots landing near the top, and the lifetime board near the top, full stop. The consistency mark sits near the bottom, the lone soft spot. Read it as a sketch: the opponents sampled here are older and fewer.

zlaas.text: Zlaas plays a complete game at the highest level: activity, bravery, and resistance all sit near the very top, and the headshot share leads everyone tracked. The matchup kill-death mark sits well above average, and the consistency mark holds near the top, so the edge survives the strongest third. Even the lifetime numbers agree, sitting near the top alongside the matchups.

zygorg.text: Zygorg fights uphill and wins anyway: a top-tier matchup rating, bravery near the top, and resistance near the top. The lifetime kill-death line sits near the top while the head-to-head kill-death figure lands above average, and headshots land near the top as well. A strong, uphill game with the lifetime board backing up the matchups.

zugiee.text: Zugiee plays like a storm front: top-shelf rating, blistering tempo, and a dueling record that stays elite no matter who steps up. The headshot share sits among the very best tracked, and the lifetime numbers back the matchups up. One crack shows against the hardest third, where the edge evaporates — and the opponent sample behind this one is older and thinner, so treat it as a sketch.

zampharosite.text: zAmpharosite plays a patient, measured game: top-tier matchup rating, bravery that keeps pace as enemies toughen, and a duel record well above average. The lifetime ledger sits squarely in the middle, and the aim stays ordinary — the matchups are the louder half of the card. A steady riser whose best work shows up where the fights are hardest.

zoiberg125rus.text: Since 2018, Zoiberg125rus has held a top-tier matchup rating: bravery and resistance well above average, and a duel tally to match. The aim stays ordinary, the lifetime ledger rests in the middle, and consistency holds mid-pack. A veteran whose matchups run hotter than the career totals.

zyw0ooo.text: zyw0ooo arrived in 2025 and already plays like a storm: tempo, bravery, kill pace, output, and accuracy all near the summit, with lifetime IvI to match. The matchup grade runs well above average, with headshots sitting above average too. Consistency holds mid-pack — the single calm line in a card that never sits still.

zeethvs.text: zeethvs plays like a storm with the throttle pinned: tempo, bravery, and kill pace all sit near the very summit, while accuracy and headshots keep pace at the same altitude, and the lifetime board rides with them. The matchup rating sits well above average, and the faceoff kill-death count holds firm beside it. Only consistency dips below average against the strongest third, the one soft seam in a card built for speed. A relentless force who rarely slows down.

zleoon.text: zLeoon runs toward the hardest fights and usually comes out ahead: bravery near the top, a blistering kill pace, and a matchup rating comfortably above average. The aim is sharp and headshots land where they count. The one wrinkle: the toughest-third line falls below average, the only line that refuses to keep up with the rest.

zachhalo1.text: zachhalo1 is steady across the whole card: rating, tempo, bravery and resistance each above average, with the kill pace keeping step and the lifetime board close behind. Accuracy and headshots sit mid-pack, and consistency lands in the same middle ground. A veteran since 2014 who rarely has a bad line on the card.
